I'll help complete the `validate` method for the `KnightBlockRule` class. Based on the task description and the reference to Chinese chess (Xiangqi) horse movement rules, a knight (horse) can be blocked if there's a piece in the adjacent square between its current position and destination.

Here's the completed method:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }
    
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    // Calculate the difference in coordinates
    int dx = Math.abs(destination.x() - source.x());
    int dy = Math.abs(destination.y() - source.y());
    
    // Check if it's a valid knight move (1 square in one direction and 2 in the other)
    if (!((dx == 1 && dy == 2) || (dx == 2 && dy == 1))) {
        return true; // Not a knight move, let other rules handle it
    }
    
    // Check for blocking piece (horse in Chinese chess is blocked if adjacent square is occupied)
    int blockX = source.x() + (destination.x() > source.x() ? dx/2 : -dx/2);
    int blockY = source.y() + (destination.y() > source.y() ? dy/2 : -dy/2);
    
    // If there's a piece in the blocking position, the move is invalid
    return game.getPiece(blockX, blockY) == null;
}
```

Explanation:
1. First checks if the moving piece is a Knight (already implemented)
2. Calculates the coordinate differences between source and destination
3. Verifies if the move follows the knight's L-shaped pattern (1 square in one direction and 2 in the other)
4. Determines the blocking position (the adjacent square between source and destination)
5. Returns true only if the blocking position is empty (no piece is blocking the knight's move)
6. Follows the Chinese chess horse movement rule where the horse can be blocked by pieces in adjacent positions

The method returns false when the knight is blocked (invalid move), and true when the move is valid according to this rule.

package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The Game class
 */
public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null
     */
    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

    /**
     * Update the score of a player according to the piece and corresponding move made by him just now.
     *
     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made
     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

    /**
     * Make a move.
     *
     * @param move the move to make
     */
    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

    /**
     * Get all available moves of one player.
     *
     * @param player the player whose available moves to get
     * @return an array of available moves
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    /**
     * Refresh the output printed in the console, which shows the following things.
     * 1. the gameboard and pieces on it
     * 2. scores of the players
     * 3. other help information
     */
    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");
        System.out.flush();

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("### COMP3021 Programming Assignment 1 ###");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");
        if (this.numMoves < this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection()) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +
                    " capture pieces or win the game.");
        }
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Total Moves: " + this.numMoves);
        // print scores of players
        for (var player :
                this.configuration.getPlayers()) {
            System.out.printf("%s%s%s score: %d\n", player.getColor(), player.getName(), Color.DEFAULT,
                    player.getScore());
        }
        System.out.println();
        // print the gameboard
        var leftPadding = 8;
        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        var borderBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        borderBuilder.append("-".repeat(Math.max(0, contents.get(0).size() * 2 - 1)));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        for (int row = contents.size() - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            System.out.printf("%" + (leftPadding - 1) + "d|%s|%d\n",
                    row + 1,
                    contents.get(row).parallelStream().map(Object::toString).collect(Collectors.joining(" ")),
                    row + 1);
        }
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

    /**
     * Get the piece in the place
     *
     * @param place the place of the piece
     * @return the piece
     */
    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(@NotNull Place place) {
        return this.board[place.x()][place.y()];
    }

    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(int x, int y) {
        return this.getPiece(new Place(x, y));
    }

    public Player getCurrentPlayer() {
        return currentPlayer != null ? currentPlayer : this.configuration.getPlayers()[0];
    }

    public Player[] getPlayers() {
        return configuration.getPlayers();
    }

    public int getNumMoves() {
        return numMoves;
    }

    public Configuration getConfiguration() {
        return configuration;
    }

    public Place getCentralPlace() {
        return configuration.getCentralPlace();
    }

    @Override
    public Game clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Game) super.clone();
        cloned.configuration = this.configuration.clone();
        cloned.board = this.board.clone();
        for (int i = 0; i < this.configuration.getSize(); i++) {
            cloned.board[i] = this.board[i].clone();
            // no need to deep copy pieces

                System.arraycopy(this.board[i], 0, cloned.board[i], 0, this.configuration.getSize());
        }
        cloned.currentPlayer = currentPlayer == null ? null : currentPlayer.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;

/**
 * Move class represent a move made by a {@link Player}, moving a piece from one {@link Place} to another {@link Place}.
 */
public class Move implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Source place of the move.
     */
    private Place source;

    /**
     * Move destination
     */
    private Place destination;

    public Move(Place source, Place destination) {
        this.source = source;
        this.destination = destination;
    }

    public Move(int sourceX, int sourceY, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(new Place(sourceX, sourceY), new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    public Move(Place source, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(source, new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    /* Getters start */
    public Place getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    public Place getDestination() {
        return destination;
    }
    /* Getters end */

    /* Object methods start */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Move move = (Move) o;
        return source.equals(move.source) &&
                destination.equals(move.destination);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(source, destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringJoiner(", ", Move.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
                .add("source=" + source)
                .add("destination=" + destination)
                .toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Move clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Move) super.clone();
        cloned.source = this.source.clone();
        cloned.destination = this.destination.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

    /* Object methods end */

}

public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {

    }
    
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    // Calculate the difference in coordinates
    int dx = Math.abs(destination.x() - source.x());
    int dy = Math.abs(destination.y() - source.y());
    
    // Check if it's a valid knight move (1 square in one direction and 2 in the other)
    if (!((dx == 1 && dy == 2) || (dx == 2 && dy == 1))) {
        return true; // Not a knight move, let other rules handle it
    }

    int blockX = source.x() + (destination.x() > source.x() ? dx/2 : -dx/2);
    int blockY = source.y() + (destination.y() > source.y() ? dy/2 : -dy/2);
    
    // If there's a piece in the blocking position, the move is invalid
    return game.getPiece(blockX, blockY) == null;

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Archer)) {
        return true;
    }
    
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place dest = move.getDestination();
    
    // Archer must move in straight line (same row or same column)
    if (source.x() != dest.x() && source.y() != dest.y()) {
        return false;
    }
    
    int dx = Integer.compare(dest.x(), source.x());
    int dy = Integer.compare(dest.y(), source.y());
    int piecesBetween = 0;
    
    Place current = new Place(source.x() + dx, source.y() + dy);
    while (!current.equals(dest)) {
        if (game.getPiece(current) != null) {
            piecesBetween++;
        }
        current = new Place(current.x() + dx, current.y() + dy);
    }
    
    Piece targetPiece = game.getPiece(dest);
    if (targetPiece == null) {
        // Moving to empty square - must have no pieces between
        return piecesBetween == 0;
    } else {
        // Capturing - must have exactly one piece between
        return piecesBetween == 1;
    }
}
```

Explanation:
1. First checks if the moving piece is an Archer (already implemented)
2. Verifies the move is straight (same row or column)
3. Counts pieces between source and destination
4. For empty destination, requires no pieces between
5. For occupied destination (capture), requires exactly one piece between
6. Follows the cannon movement rules from Chinese chess

The method returns true for valid moves and false for invalid ones according to the Archer's movement rules.

public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null

    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made

    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

I'll help complete the `validate` method for the `FirstNMovesProtectionRule` class. This rule prevents piece capturing during the first N moves of the game.

The method should:
1. Check if the current move number is within the protected range
2. If it is, verify that the move doesn't capture any piece (destination is empty)
3. Return false if the move violates the rule (tries to capture during protected moves)

Here's the complete method:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    // If we're still within protected moves
    if (game.getNumMoves() < this.numProtectedMoves) {
        // Check if destination has a piece (capture attempt)
        Piece destinationPiece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());
        if (destinationPiece != null) {
            return false; // Capture attempt during protected moves
        }
    }
    return true; // Move is valid
}
```

Explanation:
- The method first checks if the current move count is within the protected range
- If it is, it checks if the destination square has a piece (potential capture)
- Returns false if there's a capture attempt during protected moves
- Otherwise returns true (move is valid)
- The rule doesn't affect moves after the protected period

This implementation follows the rule's purpose while being efficient and clear. It uses the game's move count and checks the destination square's state to determine validity.

package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The Game class
 */
public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null
     */
    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

    /**
     * Update the score of a player according to the piece and corresponding move made by him just now.
     *
     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made
     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

    /**
     * Make a move.
     *
     * @param move the move to make
     */
    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

    /**
     * Get all available moves of one player.
     *
     * @param player the player whose available moves to get
     * @return an array of available moves
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    /**
     * Refresh the output printed in the console, which shows the following things.
     * 1. the gameboard and pieces on it
     * 2. scores of the players
     * 3. other help information
     */
    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");
        System.out.flush();

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("### COMP3021 Programming Assignment 1 ###");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");
        if (this.numMoves < this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection()) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +
                    " capture pieces or win the game.");
        }
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Total Moves: " + this.numMoves);
        // print scores of players
        for (var player :
                this.configuration.getPlayers()) {
            System.out.printf("%s%s%s score: %d\n", player.getColor(), player.getName(), Color.DEFAULT,
                    player.getScore());
        }
        System.out.println();
        // print the gameboard
        var leftPadding = 8;
        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        var borderBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        borderBuilder.append("-".repeat(Math.max(0, contents.get(0).size() * 2 - 1)));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        for (int row = contents.size() - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            System.out.printf("%" + (leftPadding - 1) + "d|%s|%d\n",
                    row + 1,
                    contents.get(row).parallelStream().map(Object::toString).collect(Collectors.joining(" ")),
                    row + 1);
        }
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

    /**
     * Get the piece in the place
     *
     * @param place the place of the piece
     * @return the piece
     */
    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(@NotNull Place place) {
        return this.board[place.x()][place.y()];
    }

    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(int x, int y) {
        return this.getPiece(new Place(x, y));
    }

    public Player getCurrentPlayer() {
        return currentPlayer != null ? currentPlayer : this.configuration.getPlayers()[0];
    }

    public Player[] getPlayers() {
        return configuration.getPlayers();
    }

    public int getNumMoves() {
        return numMoves;
    }

    public Configuration getConfiguration() {
        return configuration;
    }

    public Place getCentralPlace() {
        return configuration.getCentralPlace();
    }

    @Override
    public Game clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Game) super.clone();
        cloned.configuration = this.configuration.clone();
        cloned.board = this.board.clone();
        for (int i = 0; i < this.configuration.getSize(); i++) {
            cloned.board[i] = this.board[i].clone();
            // no need to deep copy pieces
            if (this.configuration.getSize() >= 0)
                System.arraycopy(this.board[i], 0, cloned.board[i], 0, this.configuration.getSize());
        }
        cloned.currentPlayer = currentPlayer == null ? null : currentPlayer.clone();
        return cloned;
    }
}

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;

/**
 * Move class represent a move made by a {@link Player}, moving a piece from one {@link Place} to another {@link Place}.
 */
public class Move implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Source place of the move.
     */
    private Place source;

    /**
     * Move destination
     */
    private Place destination;

    public Move(Place source, Place destination) {
        this.source = source;
        this.destination = destination;
    }

    public Move(int sourceX, int sourceY, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(new Place(sourceX, sourceY), new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    public Move(Place source, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(source, new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    /* Getters start */
    public Place getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    public Place getDestination() {
        return destination;
    }
    /* Getters end */

    /* Object methods start */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Move move = (Move) o;
        return source.equals(move.source) &&
                destination.equals(move.destination);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(source, destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringJoiner(", ", Move.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
                .add("source=" + source)
                .add("destination=" + destination)
                .toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Move clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Move) super.clone();
        cloned.source = this.source.clone();
        cloned.destination = this.destination.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

    /* Object methods end */

}

@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }
    
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    int dx = Math.abs(destination.x() - source.x());
    int dy = Math.abs(destination.y() - source.y());
    
    // Knight moves in L-shape: (2,1) or (1,2)
    return (dx == 2 && dy == 1) || (dx == 1 && dy == 2);
}

5. Returns false for any other movement pattern

This implementation correctly validates knight moves according to standard chess rules while maintaining the existing interface requirements.

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**

public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null
     */
    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

    /**
     * Update the score of a player according to the piece and corresponding move made by him just now.
     *
     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made
     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

     * Make a move.

     * @param move the move to make

    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");

        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");

            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +

        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));

        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),

        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

     * @param place the place of the piece
     * @return the piece

        return this.board[place.x()][place.y()];

    public Game clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Game) super.clone();
        cloned.configuration = this.configuration.clone();
        cloned.board = this.board.clone();
        for (int i = 0; i < this.configuration.getSize(); i++) {
            cloned.board[i] = this.board[i].clone();
            // no need to deep copy pieces

                System.arraycopy(this.board[i], 0, cloned.board[i], 0, this.configuration.getSize());
        }
        cloned.currentPlayer = currentPlayer == null ? null : currentPlayer.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;

/**
 * Move class represent a move made by a {@link Player}, moving a piece from one {@link Place} to another {@link Place}.
 */
public class Move implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Source place of the move.
     */
    private Place source;

    /**
     * Move destination
     */
    private Place destination;

    public Move(Place source, Place destination) {
        this.source = source;
        this.destination = destination;
    }

    public Move(int sourceX, int sourceY, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(new Place(sourceX, sourceY), new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    public Move(Place source, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(source, new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    /* Getters start */
    public Place getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    public Place getDestination() {
        return destination;
    }
    /* Getters end */

    /* Object methods start */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Move move = (Move) o;
        return source.equals(move.source) &&
                destination.equals(move.destination);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(source, destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringJoiner(", ", Move.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
                .add("source=" + source)
                .add("destination=" + destination)
                .toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Move clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Move) super.clone();
        cloned.source = this.source.clone();
        cloned.destination = this.destination.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

    /* Object methods end */

}

I'll help complete the `getAvailableMoves` method for the Knight class. The method should return all valid moves a knight can make from its current position, considering the chess knight's movement pattern (L-shape: 2 squares in one direction and then 1 square perpendicular).

Here's the implementation:

```java
@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    ArrayList<Move> validMoves = new ArrayList<>();
    
    // All possible knight move offsets (8 possible L-shaped moves)
    int[][] knightMoves = {
        {2, 1}, {2, -1}, {-2, 1}, {-2, -1},
        {1, 2}, {1, -2}, {-1, 2}, {-1, -2}
    };
    
    int boardSize = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    for (int[] offset : knightMoves) {
        int newX = source.x() + offset[0];
        int newY = source.y() + offset[1];
        
        // Check if new position is within board boundaries
        if (newX >= 0 && newX < boardSize && newY >= 0 && newY < boardSize) {
            Place destination = new Place(newX, newY);
            Move move = new Move(source, destination);
            
            // Validate the move using the existing validation method
            if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                validMoves.add(move);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return validMoves.toArray(new Move[0]);
}
```

Explanation:
1. The method generates all 8 possible L-shaped moves a knight can make in chess.
2. For each potential move, it checks if the destination is within the board boundaries.
3. It creates a Move object for each valid destination.
4. Each move is validated using the existing `validateMove` method which checks game rules.
5. Valid moves are collected in a list and returned as an array.

The implementation considers:
- Board boundaries (won't suggest moves that go off the board)
- Game rules (validates each move using the existing validation method)
- Returns only moves that are actually playable according to the game rules

The method returns an empty array if no valid moves are available from the current position.

@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    ArrayList<Move> validMoves = new ArrayList<>();

	private boolean validateMove(Game game, Move move) {
		var rules = new Rule[] { new OutOfBoundaryRule(), new OccupiedRule(), new VacantRule(), new NilMoveRule(),
				new FirstNMovesProtectionRule(game.getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()), new KnightMoveRule(),
				new KnightBlockRule(), };

				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Player interface for the game.
 * Implementations could be computer player or human player.
 */
public abstract class Player implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * The name of a player.
     * By default, name is a unique identifier to distinguish different players. But this can be overrided by
     * overriding {@link Player#equals(Object)} method.
     */
    protected final String name;

    /**
     * The game score of this player.
     * Score will be updated whenever the player makes a move through {@link Game#updateScore(Player, Piece, Move)}
     * and {@link Player#setScore(int)}
     */
    protected int score;

    /**
     * The color representing this player
     */
    protected final Color color;

    public Player(String name, Color color) {
        this.name = name;
        this.color = color;
    }


    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Player player = (Player) o;
        return name.equals(player.name);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(name);
    }

    public final String getName() {
        return this.name;
    }

    public final int getScore() {
        return score;
    }

    public final void setScore(int score) {
        this.score = score;
    }

    public String toString() {
        return this.name;
    }

    /**
     * Get color used to represent this player.
     *
     * @return color of this player
     */
    public final Color getColor() {
        return this.color;
    }

    @Override
    public Player clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        return (Player) super.clone();
    }

    /**
     * Choose a move from available moves.
     * This method will be called by {@link Game} object to get the move that the player wants to make when it is the
     * player's turn.
     *
     * @param game           the current game object
     * @param availableMoves available moves for this player to choose from.
     * @return the chosen move
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves);

}

package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The Game class
 */
public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null
     */
    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

    /**
     * Update the score of a player according to the piece and corresponding move made by him just now.
     *
     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made
     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

    /**
     * Make a move.
     *
     * @param move the move to make
     */
    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

    /**
     * Get all available moves of one player.
     *
     * @param player the player whose available moves to get
     * @return an array of available moves
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    /**
     * Refresh the output printed in the console, which shows the following things.
     * 1. the gameboard and pieces on it
     * 2. scores of the players
     * 3. other help information
     */
    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");
        System.out.flush();

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("### COMP3021 Programming Assignment 1 ###");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");
        if (this.numMoves < this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection()) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +
                    " capture pieces or win the game.");
        }
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Total Moves: " + this.numMoves);
        // print scores of players
        for (var player :
                this.configuration.getPlayers()) {
            System.out.printf("%s%s%s score: %d\n", player.getColor(), player.getName(), Color.DEFAULT,
                    player.getScore());
        }
        System.out.println();
        // print the gameboard
        var leftPadding = 8;
        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        var borderBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        borderBuilder.append("-".repeat(Math.max(0, contents.get(0).size() * 2 - 1)));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        for (int row = contents.size() - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            System.out.printf("%" + (leftPadding - 1) + "d|%s|%d\n",
                    row + 1,
                    contents.get(row).parallelStream().map(Object::toString).collect(Collectors.joining(" ")),
                    row + 1);
        }
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

    /**
     * Get the piece in the place
     *
     * @param place the place of the piece
     * @return the piece
     */
    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(@NotNull Place place) {
        return this.board[place.x()][place.y()];
    }

    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(int x, int y) {
        return this.getPiece(new Place(x, y));
    }

    public Player getCurrentPlayer() {
        return currentPlayer != null ? currentPlayer : this.configuration.getPlayers()[0];
    }

    public Player[] getPlayers() {
        return configuration.getPlayers();
    }

    public int getNumMoves() {
        return numMoves;
    }

    public Configuration getConfiguration() {
        return configuration;
    }

    public Place getCentralPlace() {
        return configuration.getCentralPlace();
    }

    @Override
    public Game clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Game) super.clone();
        cloned.configuration = this.configuration.clone();
        cloned.board = this.board.clone();
        for (int i = 0; i < this.configuration.getSize(); i++) {
            cloned.board[i] = this.board[i].clone();
            // no need to deep copy pieces
            if (this.configuration.getSize() >= 0)
                System.arraycopy(this.board[i], 0, cloned.board[i], 0, this.configuration.getSize());
        }
        cloned.currentPlayer = currentPlayer == null ? null : currentPlayer.clone();
        return cloned;
    }
}

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;

/**
 * Move class represent a move made by a {@link Player}, moving a piece from one {@link Place} to another {@link Place}.
 */
public class Move implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Source place of the move.
     */
    private Place source;

    /**
     * Move destination
     */
    private Place destination;

    public Move(Place source, Place destination) {
        this.source = source;
        this.destination = destination;
    }

    public Move(int sourceX, int sourceY, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(new Place(sourceX, sourceY), new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    public Move(Place source, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(source, new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    /* Getters start */
    public Place getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    public Place getDestination() {
        return destination;
    }
    /* Getters end */

    /* Object methods start */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Move move = (Move) o;
        return source.equals(move.source) &&
                destination.equals(move.destination);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(source, destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringJoiner(", ", Move.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
                .add("source=" + source)
                .add("destination=" + destination)
                .toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Move clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Move) super.clone();
        cloned.source = this.source.clone();
        cloned.destination = this.destination.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

    /* Object methods end */

}

/**
 * A square (position, place) in the gameboard.

     * y coordinate
     */
    private final int y;

        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Place place = (Place) o;

                y == place.y;

     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

    /**
     * Make a move.
     *
     * @param move the move to make
     */
    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    /**
     * Refresh the output printed in the console, which shows the following things.
     * 1. the gameboard and pieces on it
     * 2. scores of the players
     * 3. other help information

    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");
        System.out.flush();

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("### COMP3021 Programming Assignment 1 ###");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");
        if (this.numMoves < this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection()) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +
                    " capture pieces or win the game.");
        }
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Total Moves: " + this.numMoves);
        // print scores of players
        for (var player :
                this.configuration.getPlayers()) {
            System.out.printf("%s%s%s score: %d\n", player.getColor(), player.getName(), Color.DEFAULT,
                    player.getScore());
        }
        System.out.println();
        // print the gameboard
        var leftPadding = 8;
        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        var borderBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        borderBuilder.append("-".repeat(Math.max(0, contents.get(0).size() * 2 - 1)));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());

                borderBuilder.toString());
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

    /**

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;

/**
 * Move class represent a move made by a {@link Player}, moving a piece from one {@link Place} to another {@link Place}.
 */
public class Move implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Source place of the move.
     */
    private Place source;

    /**
     * Move destination
     */
    private Place destination;

    public Move(Place source, Place destination) {
        this.source = source;
        this.destination = destination;
    }

    public Move(int sourceX, int sourceY, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(new Place(sourceX, sourceY), new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    public Move(Place source, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(source, new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    /* Getters start */
    public Place getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    public Place getDestination() {
        return destination;
    }
    /* Getters end */

    /* Object methods start */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Move move = (Move) o;
        return source.equals(move.source) &&
                destination.equals(move.destination);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(source, destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringJoiner(", ", Move.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
                .add("source=" + source)
                .add("destination=" + destination)
                .toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Move clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Move) super.clone();
        cloned.source = this.source.clone();
        cloned.destination = this.destination.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

    /* Object methods end */

}

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    int boardSize = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    // Check if source is within bounds
    boolean sourceValid = source.x() >= 0 && source.x() < boardSize && 
                         source.y() >= 0 && source.y() < boardSize;
    
    // Check if destination is within bounds
    boolean destinationValid = destination.x() >= 0 && destination.x() < boardSize && 
                             destination.y() >= 0 && destination.y() < boardSize;
    
    return sourceValid && destinationValid;
}
```

- Checks if both x and y coordinates of both places are within the valid range (0 to boardSize-1)

I'll help complete the `getAvailableMoves` method for the `Archer` class. Based on the Wikipedia link provided, the Archer (Cannon) moves like a rook (horizontally or vertically any number of squares), but captures by jumping exactly one piece (friend or foe) along the path.

Here's the implementation:

```java
@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    ArrayList<Move> validMoves = new ArrayList<>();
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    // Check all horizontal and vertical directions
    int[][] directions = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};
    
    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        int dx = dir[0];
        int dy = dir[1];
        boolean hasJumped = false;
        
        // Move in this direction until we hit the board boundary
        for (int step = 1; ; step++) {
            int newX = source.x() + step * dx;
            int newY = source.y() + step * dy;
            
            // Check if we're still on the board
            if (newX < 0 || newX >= size || newY < 0 || newY >= size) {
                break;
            }
            
            Place dest = new Place(newX, newY);
            Move move = new Move(source, dest);
            
            // For non-capture moves (must move to empty square without jumping)
            if (!hasJumped) {
                if (game.getPiece(dest) == null) {
                    if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                        validMoves.add(move);
                    }
                } else {
                    // Found a piece - now we can consider jumps over it
                    hasJumped = true;
                }
            } 
            // For capture moves (must jump exactly one piece and land on opponent)
            else {
                Piece target = game.getPiece(dest);
                if (target != null) {
                    if (!target.getPlayer().equals(this.getPlayer()) && validateMove(game, move)) {
                        validMoves.add(move);
                    }
                    break; // Can't jump over multiple pieces
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return validMoves.toArray(new Move[0]);
}
```

This implementation:
1. Checks all four directions (up, down, left, right)
2. For each direction, moves until it hits the board boundary
3. For non-capture moves:
   - Can move to any empty square along the path
   - Cannot jump over any pieces
4. For capture moves:
   - Must jump exactly one piece (any color)
   - Must land on an opponent's piece
5. Uses the existing `validateMove` method to check additional game rules
6. Returns all valid moves in an array

The method follows the Cannon's movement rules from Chinese Chess while respecting the game's validation rules through the `validateMove` method.

	private boolean validateMove(Game game, Move move) {

package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Player interface for the game.
 * Implementations could be computer player or human player.
 */
public abstract class Player implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * The name of a player.
     * By default, name is a unique identifier to distinguish different players. But this can be overrided by
     * overriding {@link Player#equals(Object)} method.
     */
    protected final String name;

    /**
     * The game score of this player.
     * Score will be updated whenever the player makes a move through {@link Game#updateScore(Player, Piece, Move)}
     * and {@link Player#setScore(int)}
     */
    protected int score;

    /**
     * The color representing this player
     */
    protected final Color color;

    public Player(String name, Color color) {
        this.name = name;
        this.color = color;
    }


    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Player player = (Player) o;
        return name.equals(player.name);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(name);
    }

    public final String getName() {
        return this.name;
    }

    public final int getScore() {
        return score;
    }

    public final void setScore(int score) {
        this.score = score;
    }

    public String toString() {
        return this.name;
    }

    /**
     * Get color used to represent this player.
     *
     * @return color of this player
     */
    public final Color getColor() {
        return this.color;
    }

    @Override
    public Player clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        return (Player) super.clone();
    }

    /**
     * Choose a move from available moves.
     * This method will be called by {@link Game} object to get the move that the player wants to make when it is the
     * player's turn.
     *
     * @param game           the current game object
     * @param availableMoves available moves for this player to choose from.
     * @return the chosen move
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves);

}

package assignment.protocol;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The Game class
 */
public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null
     */
    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

    /**
     * Update the score of a player according to the piece and corresponding move made by him just now.
     *
     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made
     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

    /**
     * Make a move.
     *
     * @param move the move to make
     */
    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

    /**
     * Get all available moves of one player.
     *
     * @param player the player whose available moves to get
     * @return an array of available moves
     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    /**
     * Refresh the output printed in the console, which shows the following things.
     * 1. the gameboard and pieces on it
     * 2. scores of the players
     * 3. other help information
     */
    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");
        System.out.flush();

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("### COMP3021 Programming Assignment 1 ###");
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");
        if (this.numMoves < this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection()) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +
                    " capture pieces or win the game.");
        }
        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("Total Moves: " + this.numMoves);
        // print scores of players
        for (var player :
                this.configuration.getPlayers()) {
            System.out.printf("%s%s%s score: %d\n", player.getColor(), player.getName(), Color.DEFAULT,
                    player.getScore());
        }
        System.out.println();
        // print the gameboard
        var leftPadding = 8;
        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        var borderBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        borderBuilder.append("-".repeat(Math.max(0, contents.get(0).size() * 2 - 1)));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        for (int row = contents.size() - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            System.out.printf("%" + (leftPadding - 1) + "d|%s|%d\n",
                    row + 1,
                    contents.get(row).parallelStream().map(Object::toString).collect(Collectors.joining(" ")),
                    row + 1);
        }
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

    /**
     * Get the piece in the place
     *
     * @param place the place of the piece
     * @return the piece
     */
    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(@NotNull Place place) {
        return this.board[place.x()][place.y()];
    }

    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(int x, int y) {
        return this.getPiece(new Place(x, y));
    }

    public Player getCurrentPlayer() {
        return currentPlayer != null ? currentPlayer : this.configuration.getPlayers()[0];
    }

    public Player[] getPlayers() {
        return configuration.getPlayers();
    }

    public int getNumMoves() {
        return numMoves;
    }

    public Configuration getConfiguration() {
        return configuration;
    }

    public Place getCentralPlace() {
        return configuration.getCentralPlace();
    }

    @Override
    public Game clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Game) super.clone();
        cloned.configuration = this.configuration.clone();
        cloned.board = this.board.clone();
        for (int i = 0; i < this.configuration.getSize(); i++) {
            cloned.board[i] = this.board[i].clone();
            // no need to deep copy pieces
            if (this.configuration.getSize() >= 0)
                System.arraycopy(this.board[i], 0, cloned.board[i], 0, this.configuration.getSize());
        }
        cloned.currentPlayer = currentPlayer == null ? null : currentPlayer.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Move class represent a move made by a {@link Player}, moving a piece from one {@link Place} to another {@link Place}.
 */
public class Move implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Source place of the move.
     */
    private Place source;

    /**
     * Move destination
     */
    private Place destination;

    public Move(Place source, Place destination) {
        this.source = source;
        this.destination = destination;
    }

    public Move(int sourceX, int sourceY, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(new Place(sourceX, sourceY), new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    public Move(Place source, int destinationX, int destinationY) {
        this(source, new Place(destinationX, destinationY));
    }

    /* Getters start */
    public Place getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    public Place getDestination() {
        return destination;
    }
    /* Getters end */

    /* Object methods start */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        Move move = (Move) o;
        return source.equals(move.source) &&
                destination.equals(move.destination);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(source, destination);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return new StringJoiner(", ", Move.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
                .add("source=" + source)
                .add("destination=" + destination)
                .toString();
    }

    @Override
    public Move clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
        var cloned = (Move) super.clone();
        cloned.source = this.source.clone();
        cloned.destination = this.destination.clone();
        return cloned;
    }

    /* Object methods end */

}

package assignment.protocol;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.StringJoiner;

/**
 * A square (position, place) in the gameboard.
 * Represented by coordinates a 2-D coordinate system.
 * <p>
 * x and y coordinates of a place on gameboard are two fields of this class.
 */
public class Place implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * x coordinate
     */
    private final int x;

    /**
     * y coordinate
     */
    private final int y;

    public Place(int x, int y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
    }

                .add(String.valueOf(y))

    }

    }

@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    ArrayList<Move> validMoves = new ArrayList<>();
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    // Check all horizontal and vertical directions
    int[][] directions = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};
    
    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        int dx = dir[0];
        int dy = dir[1];
        boolean hasJumped = false;
        
        // Move in this direction until we hit the board boundary
        for (int step = 1; ; step++) {
            int newX = source.x() + step * dx;
            int newY = source.y() + step * dy;
            
            // Check if we're still on the board
            if (newX < 0 || newX >= size || newY < 0 || newY >= size) {
                break;
            }
            
            Place dest = new Place(newX, newY);
            Move move = new Move(source, dest);
            
            // For non-capture moves (must move to empty square without jumping)
            if (!hasJumped) {
                if (game.getPiece(dest) == null) {
                    if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                        validMoves.add(move);
                    }
                } else {
                    // Found a piece - now we can consider jumps over it
                    hasJumped = true;
                }
            } 
            // For capture moves (must jump exactly one piece and land on opponent)
            else {
                Piece target = game.getPiece(dest);
                if (target != null) {
                    if (!target.getPlayer().equals(this.getPlayer()) && validateMove(game, move)) {
                        validMoves.add(move);
                    }
                    break; // Can't jump over multiple pieces
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return validMoves.toArray(new Move[0]);

@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    Piece movingPiece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
    Piece destinationPiece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());
    
    // If there's no piece at destination or the piece belongs to a different player, move is valid

        return true;
    }
    // If destination has a piece from the same player, move is invalid

}

   - The piece at the destination belongs to a different player (`!destinationPiece.getPlayer().equals(movingPiece.getPlayer())`)
4. Otherwise, the move is invalid (returns false) because it would capture a piece belonging to the same player.

This implementation follows the rule's description that "a piece should not go to a destination where there is another piece belonging to the same player."

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
 * The Game class
 */
public abstract class Game implements Cloneable {
    /**
     * Game configuration
     */
    protected Configuration configuration;

    /**
     * The gameboard, which is a 2-dimensional array of {@link Piece}, representing all the {@link Place} (squares) on
     * the board.
     * If there is a piece in some {@link Place} place(x,y), then {@code board[place.x()][place.y()]} will be the
     * piece object, otherwise null.
     * In other words, the board is a 2-D array with length equal to size of the board in both dimensions.
     */
    protected Piece[][] board;

    /**
     * Current player who is supposed to make a move.
     */
    protected Player currentPlayer;

    /**
     * The current number of moves made by two players
     */
    protected int numMoves = 0;

    public Game(Configuration configuration) {
        this.configuration = configuration;
        this.board = configuration.getInitialBoard();
    }

    /**
     * Start the game
     * Players will take turns according to the order in {@link Configuration#getPlayers()} to make a move until
     * a player wins.
     *
     * @return the winner
     */
    public abstract Player start();

    /**
     * Get the winner of the game. If there is no winner yet, return null;
     *
     * @param lastPlayer the last player who makes a move
     * @param lastPiece the last piece that is moved by the player
     * @param lastMove   the last move made by lastPlayer
     * @return the winner if it exists, otherwise return null
     */
    public abstract Player getWinner(Player lastPlayer, Piece lastPiece, Move lastMove);

    /**
     * Update the score of a player according to the piece and corresponding move made by him just now.
     *
     * @param player the player who just makes a move
     * @param piece  the piece that is just moved
     * @param move   the move that is just made
     */
    public abstract void updateScore(Player player, Piece piece, Move move);

     * Make a move.

     * @param move the move to make

    public abstract void movePiece(@NotNull Move move);

     */
    public abstract @NotNull Move[] getAvailableMoves(Player player);

    public void refreshOutput() {
        var size = this.configuration.getSize();
        var contents = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        for (int row = size - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
            var rowContent = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (int col = 0; col < size; col++) {
                var piece = this.getPiece(col, row);
                if (piece == null) {
                    if (this.getCentralPlace().equals(new Place(col, row))) {
                        rowContent.add("x");
                    } else {
                        rowContent.add(".");
                    }
                } else {
                    var player = piece.getPlayer();
                    rowContent.add(String.format("%s%c%s",
                            player.getColor(),
                            piece.getLabel(),
                            Color.DEFAULT));
                }
            }
            contents.add(rowContent);
        }
        var xCoordinates = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            xCoordinates.add(String.valueOf((char) ('a' + i)));
        }
        Collections.reverse(contents);

        // clear screen
        System.out.print("\u001b[2J");
        System.out.flush();

        System.out.println("### COMP3021 Programming Assignment 1 ###");

        System.out.println("Guide: to move a piece, input the coordinate of source and the destination.");
        System.out.println("For example: a1->b2 means to move the piece at 'a1' to 'b2'");
        if (this.numMoves < this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection()) {
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("Notice: first " + this.configuration.getNumMovesProtection() + " moves are not allowed to" +
                    " capture pieces or win the game.");
        }

        System.out.println("Total Moves: " + this.numMoves);

        }
        System.out.println();
        // print the gameboard

        var paddingSpaceBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        paddingSpaceBuilder.append(" ".repeat(leftPadding));
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),

        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),

        for (int row = contents.size() - 1; row >= 0; row--) {

                    row + 1,

        }
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                borderBuilder.toString());
        System.out.printf("%s%s\n",
                paddingSpaceBuilder.toString(),
                xCoordinates.parallelStream()
                        .collect(Collectors.joining(" ")));
        System.out.println();
    }

     *
     * @param place the place of the piece
     * @return the piece
     */
    public @Nullable Piece getPiece(@NotNull Place place) {
        return this.board[place.x()][place.y()];
    }

        return this.getPiece(new Place(x, y));
    }

    public Player getCurrentPlayer() {

        return configuration.getPlayers();
    }
